description: IN-SAMPLE REGRESSION SET (not a validation corpus). Written after earlier failures were observed and includes previously reported probe texts; a full match only proves fixed bugs stay fixed, not generalization. Covers detection of asymmetric obligations, agent deletion, speculative hedging, collective-pronoun calibration, and non-contractual prose guards across EN, RU, ES, DE, KK, and ZH.
